reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text: This is the serum I use every night. After applying it, I use my Medicube AGE-R Booster Pro to help it absorb. It's hydrating, relaxing, and so easy to use. ✨💙
reviews.zh: 呢支係我每晚都用嘅精華。搽完之後我會用 Medicube AGE-R Booster Pro 幫助吸收。保濕、紓緩，用起上嚟好輕鬆。✨💙

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text: This is the third bottle I’ve purchased. It’s so good! I use it before applying makeup and as part of my skincare routine. I absolutely love it.
reviews.zh: 已經係我買嘅第三支。好好用！我會喺化妝前用，亦會加入日常護膚程序入面。我真係超級鍾意。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I used the previous version and I thought it was great but I was a little concerned when the formula got upgraded, but I love this new version more than the first one 😊
reviews.zh: 我用過舊版，本來覺得已經好好用，但係見到配方升級嗰陣都有少少擔心，不過呢個新版本我仲鍾意多過第一版 😊

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text: all time favourite serum. i have really sensitive skin and this i use this everyday! love the face mask also
reviews.zh: 一生至愛嘅精華。我皮膚真係好敏感，呢支我日日都用！面膜我都好鍾意。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text: One of my most purchased products! Great hydration from deep within the skin. Works well with my acne prone sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 係我回購最多嘅產品之一！由肌底深層保濕，功效好好。對我呢種易爆瘡嘅敏感肌都好啱用。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text:
Love this!!
A super simple yet effective hyaluronic acid serum, very hydrating, light weight and fast absorbing
I have acne prone skin and it doesn’t cause me to break out OR irritate my skin!
reviews.zh: 超鍾意呢支！！一支好簡單但有效嘅透明質酸精華，超級保濕、質地輕盈、吸收得好快。我係易爆瘡嘅膚質，用完都唔會爆瘡亦唔會刺激到我塊面！

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text:
I'm really enjoying this upgrade~ 
It's honestly better now, i thought it was just ok when I last tried it but now i love it c:

Its more lightweight, and WAY less sticky then it used to be. I feel like it sinks deeper into the skin as well 🩵
reviews.zh:
我真係好享受呢個升級版～
老實講而家好咗好多，上次試過覺得一般，但而家我超鍾意 c:

輕盈咗好多，而且比以前黏笠感少咗超多。感覺更加滲入皮膚🩵

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Lightweight, hydrating, and absorbs quickly. It doesn't feel sticky and layers well with the rest of my skincare. My skin feels soft and comfortable after using it.
reviews.zh: 輕盈、保濕，而且吸收得快。唔會覺得黏笠，同其他護膚品都夾得好。用完之後皮膚感覺柔軟舒適。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
